name: Botanical plates
description: Hand-coloured botanical plates and studies of flowers, fruit and plants, from Dutch tulip books to the great Paris flower folios.

works.alt_text: A botanical plate of a pink wild rose on a leafy stem against cream paper.
Purple, blue and golden plums on leafy twigs against a dark brown background.
A cluster of yellow narcissus flowers rising from a bulb, painted on cream paper.
White and pale blue passion flowers with dark green leaves and an orange fruit, climbing a dark fluted column against a cloudy sky.
A single red and white striped tulip on a long green stem, painted on pale paper.
A rounded head of lilac rhododendron flowers above long dark leaves, with a butterfly and a bee, against a cloudy sky and hills.
A leafy plant with pink and white trumpet flowers, a yellow-flowered sprig and two butterflies, on cream paper with a Latin title.
A woven basket on a stone ledge holding large ruffled marigolds with anemones, tulips and sprays of white jasmine.
Two deep crimson and purple roses with buds and green leaves on cream paper.
A climbing morning glory vine with blue and purple flowers and heart-shaped leaves on cream paper.
A crown imperial plant with a ring of coral-red bell-shaped flowers beneath a tuft of green leaves.
A single pink and red carnation with frilled petals on a slender stem, its name written in brown script below.
